notes.title: MoDian Crowdfunding Pre-registration Now Open
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444191/93d2586b3803f2d5bf0ebb8c358fa8368689d0d3.png[/img]

The long-awaited MoDian crowdfunding campaign has officially begun pre-registration, with a Kickstarter (KS) campaign also in planning!

[h3]Latest Crowdfunding Details[/h3]
Pre-registration Period: April 21st, 14:00 (UTC+8)
Crowdfunding Launch: April 29th, 17:00 (UTC+8)
Platform: @MoDian (a renowned crowdfunding community in China)


Through this campaign, we aim to deliver exclusive high-quality merchandise to supporters.

[url=https://zhongchou.modian.com/item/145899.html?utm_source=Appshare&utm_content=1591514&utm_term=145899&utm_campaign=project]Click to View Details[/url]

Additionally, a Kickstarter campaign is currently under development—stay tuned for future announcements!

notes.title: Forsaker : DingDing&Blade Update Notes for Version 1.28
notes.content:
1.Fixed the display issue of the active skill list during battles.

2.The game has been optimized for display on 【16:10】 screen resolutions.

3.Fixed description issues for certain card attributes.

4.Fixed issues with the display of some storylines when the language is set to English.
